statistics.mean: Arithmetic mean across defined trained-seed values.
statistics.sample_sd: Sample SD across trained seeds, denominator n-1; all three values and undefined counts are retained.
statistics.paired: Left minus right within the same trained seed; diagnostic treatment minus none within the same complete inherited state.
statistics.undefined: Zero-denominator rates remain null; n_total is three and n_undefined is explicit.

cost_definitions.stage_wall_seconds: Final saved seconds minus inherited A saved seconds; resumptions and concurrent GPU execution affect throughput.
cost_definitions.forward_recurrent_macs: Two Heun field evaluations per .25 live tick times recurrent matrix MACs, batch and ticks; excludes encoder/head, backpropagation and optimizer arithmetic.
cost_definitions.branch_metrics: One saved continuation boundary, recomputed on CPU; not a trajectory distribution or independent replicate.

limits: All arms already have complete directed graphs; this tests richer nonlinear field interactions, not newly invented graph cycles.
Two extension arms match added scalars and dense MACs; their features, derivatives and conditioning differ.
Joint clipping includes V, so old parameters can change differently at the first optimizer step.
Squared features and recipient/source products both break the odd symmetry of the original autonomous field.
Longer-horizon timing is not general reasoning or continual-learning mastery.
Setting learned V to zero at evaluation is a counterfactual ablation, not an alternative trained model.
